svg.title: Azure Cost Intelligence Platform — full architecture
svg.desc: Multi-subscription Azure cost platform: React dashboard, FastAPI backend, LangGraph agent, MCP cost tools, PostgreSQL, all running on AKS with Managed Identity auth

g.text: Cost overview · Resource drilldown · Savings tracker · Budget alerts
Entra ID SSO · REST + SSE · subscription context injection
Streamable HTTP · one tool per resource type · multi-subscription aware
Workload Identity (Managed Identity) — zero credentials in code
Multi-subscription: sub-A · sub-B · sub-C … (same Entra tenant)
